set.body:
Scope

Implement S12 and S15 through public APIs, either as two focused scenarios or one documented paired fixture.

Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The experimental design combines sustained instruction/task blocks with transient cues, errors or feedback, impulses, and variable-duration epochs.
- [ ] Phase/term-specific canonical, informed, or FIR HRFs are represented structurally.
- [ ] Sampled nuisance regressors include realistic motion parameters, derivatives, squares where declared, CompCor-like components, spike regressors, and constants.
- [ ] Sampled regressors validate scan/run alignment directly and are never represented as events with an identity HRF.
- [ ] Per-run intercept and drift construction is distinct from task coefficient scope.
- [ ] The fixture includes duplicate/near-collinear nuisance pressure and verifies the declared empty/rank policy and alias diagnostics.
- [ ] Planted task effects remain recoverable within condition-aware tolerances after nuisance adjustment.
- [ ] Structural columns, scaling/centering receipts, run scope, rank evidence, and result provenance are asserted.
- [ ] Independent direct-QR/external fit evidence is labelled separately from design-construction evidence.
- [ ] Both scenarios return clean Pass, are registered with receipts, and run on JVM and Scala.js without internal APIs or manual contrast bookkeeping.
set.title: P3.3: add mixed block/transient and realistic nuisance acceptance scenarios
